name: LY-2183240
summary: LY-2183240 is a drug which acts both as a potent inhibitor of the reuptake of the endocannabinoid anandamide and as an inhibitor of fatty acid amide hydrolase (FAAH), the primary enzyme responsible for degrading anandamide. This leads to markedly elevated anandamide levels in the brain, and LY-2183240 has been shown to produce both analgesic and anxiolytic effects in animal models.

pharmacology.text: LY-2183240 is a drug which acts both as a potent inhibitor of the reuptake of the endocannabinoid anandamide and as an inhibitor of fatty acid amide hydrolase (FAAH), the primary enzyme responsible for degrading anandamide. While LY-2183240 is a potent inhibitor of FAAH, it has relatively poor selectivity and also inhibits several other enzyme side targets.

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of the endocannabinoid system, not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是一種研究用化合物，用於內源性大麻素系統的實驗室研究，並非藥品。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种研究用化合物，用于内源性大麻素系统的实验室研究，并非药品。

fact.en: It raises levels of anandamide, an endocannabinoid named after the Sanskrit word ananda, meaning bliss.
fact.zh: 它會提高大麻素「安南達胺」的濃度，這個名字來自梵文 ananda，意思是「極樂」。
fact.zhHans: 它会提高大麻素「安南达胺」的浓度，这个名字来自梵文 ananda，意思是「极乐」。
